entities.summary: Baron Carl Nils Daniel Bildt was a Swedish diplomat and historian. He was Swedish envoy to the United Kingdom 1902–1905, but spent most of his Foreign Office career as Swedish envoy in Rome and published extensively on Swedish historical topics relating to Rome and Italy.
